column1: # p419 · 2026-10-24 · T101's MECHANISM, one pass after p418 registered T101 ("a length is not an identity").
# Two different projects' MIT payloads are both EXACTLY 1065 B with different digests; cmp separates them at char 1, line 1.
# The equality is four deltas summing to zero: +3 B extra blank lines, -1 B missing terminal newline, -2 B shorter holder name.
# So the collision is reachable BY CONSTRUCTION: whitespace presentation and holder-name length trade byte for byte.

# T102: a LINE-BASED read of GradeU's payload returns 1066 B, because line tools re-add the terminal newline it lacks. This is the same off-by-one p418 corrected from a carried 1,066 to 1065 on OpenMAIC.
